1067: I make one request to everyone who has to beg: if you must ask, never ask people who hide what they have.
1068: Begging is like an unsafe little boat. When it hits the rock of someone who hides what they have, it breaks apart.
1069: Just thinking about begging makes the heart melt with sadness. Thinking of people who hide what they have and refuse breaks it completely.
1082: When she looks back at me, it is as if a goddess who attacks had come with a whole army.
1103: Is the heaven of the god with lotus-flower eyes any sweeter than sleeping on the soft shoulders of the one you love?
1105: The shoulders of the girl with flowers in her hair give me joy, just like each thing I long for gives joy at the moment I want it.
1110: The more you learn, the more you see how much you do not know. In the same way, each time I come close to my jeweled love, my love for her feels new again.
1112: My heart, whenever you see flowers you get confused and think her eyes are like them. But flowers can be seen by anyone, and her eyes are not like that.
1137: There is nothing as great as a woman who suffers a love as big as the sea and still never rides the palm-stem horse.
1155: If you want to save me, stop my husband from going. Once he has left, it will be hard for us to be together again.
1156: If he is cruel enough to tell me to my face that he is leaving, it is hard to keep hoping he will come back and be kind to me.
1160: Many people, it seems, can bear the unbearable, push away the pain, live through being apart, and still go on living afterwards.
1178: There is someone who wanted me but did not truly care for me. And yet my eyes cannot rest without seeing him.
1189: If the man who sweetly talked me into letting him go is doing well, then let my body turn as pale as it wants.
